families.name: goodui.line-chart
families.note: A two-series monthly-temperature specimen. Card is a linked GoodUI instance. Source rows, axis values, line labels, palette overrides, and optional icon-button data-table state are runtime configuration.

families.name: goodui.bar-chart
families.note: Grouped four-quarter vertical specimen with two series in theme-aware marker blue and teal. The Card is a linked GoodUI instance; source rows and data-table state are runtime configuration.

families.name: goodui.bar-chart.horizontal
families.note: Horizontal four-quarter specimen with a linked GoodUI Card, token-bound blue and teal bars, and the same logical X category/Y value contract as the vertical state.

families.name: goodui.sparkline
families.note: Compact single-series specimen with marker-blue line and a surface-filled endpoint. Small and large sizes, custom width/color, empty/error states, and grouping are runtime options; no Card is part of the component.

families.name: goodui.scatter-chart
families.note: Two-series 2D specimen with linked Card and theme-aware blue and teal markers. Repeated X positions remain separate dots; the data-table view and palette overrides are runtime options.

families.name: goodui.chart-scatter
families.note: Single-series 2D point specimen. The Angular tag configures ScatterChart and does not render alone.

families.name: goodui.histogram
families.note: Two-source specimen with a linked GoodUI Card, shared equal-width intervals, and token-bound marker blue and teal.

families.name: goodui.chart-histogram
families.note: One-series equal-width bin specimen. The Angular tag configures Histogram and does not render alone.

families.name: goodui.chart-axis
families.note: The specimen shows X and Y labels together for reference. Each declarative Angular tag configures one axis and does not render alone.

families.name: goodui.chart-bar
families.note: One-bar-series reference. The declarative Angular tag configures a series inside BarChart and does not render alone.

families.name: goodui.chart-line
families.note: The specimen shows one line. The declarative Angular tag configures a series inside LineChart and does not render alone.
